vol.name: The Toxic Avenger vs The Noxious Offender

title: The Toxic Avenger vs The Noxious Offender #1
desc: A new series from the twisted mind of master Toxie writer Matt Bors! An evil duplicate of the Toxic Avenger appears in our dimension, which is bad. And Toxie’s estranged father shows up, which might be worse. Featuring a classic comic variant cover and a photo montage cover from Toxie’s home, Troma Entertainment!
